title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were chosen from the cited articles on PCMag, CNET, Consumer Reports and Dobot’s product list, favoring items mentioned by multiple sources.
assumptions: No pricing details were included because the sources did not provide them for most products.

verdict.pick: Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum with OmniGrip Mechanical Arm
verdict.line: Buy the Saros Z70 if you want a robot vacuum that also lifts small items around the house. It combines strong cleaning performance with an OmniGrip arm, but expect occasional software glitches.
